words.zh: n. 海报；招贴
words.example: The students made a poster to remind everyone to protect wild animals.

words.zh: adj. 非法的；  n. 非法移民，非法劳工；间谍
words.example: Poaching these animals is illegal and punishable by law.

words.zh: adv. 非法地
words.example: Some people hunt rare birds illegally for their feathers.

words.zh: n. 打猎；搜寻；  v. 追捕；搜索；打猎；寻找，搜寻；猎取；猎杀
words.example: Lions hunt in groups to catch large animals on the grassland.

words.zh: n. 猎人；猎犬；搜寻者；猎户座；追逐者
words.example: The hunter followed the animal tracks through the forest.

words.zh: adv. 马上；直接地；靠近地；  conj. 一……（就）
words.example: When you see a wild animal, stop immediately and do not run.

words.zh: n. 物种；种类；人类；【化】形态；【生】物种；  adj. 物种上的
words.example: Many endangered species depend on protected areas for survival.

words.zh: n. 鲨鱼；骗子
words.example: The shark is often wrongly seen as a cruel killer of the sea.

words.zh: n. 鳍；  v. 切去（鱼的）鳍
words.example: Shark fin soup has caused a sharp decline in shark populations.

words.zh: phr. 到底，究竟；根本，完全
words.example: Why on earth would anyone harm such a beautiful creature?

words.zh: phr. 灭绝，绝种；消失
words.example: Many animal species will die out if we do not protect their habitats.

words.zh: adj. 惊人的，令人恐慌的
words.example: The alarming decrease in elephant numbers worries many scientists.

words.zh: n. 警报器，警报；闹钟；惊恐，忧虑；  v. 使惊恐，使忧虑
words.example: The alarm sounded loudly when the fire broke out in the lab.

words.zh: v. 评估，评价；定等级，评级；认为；  n. 速度，速率；率，比率；价格，价钱；等级；频率；【数】比率
words.example: Experts rate the snow leopard as a highly endangered species.

words.zh: n. 评价；等级；等级评定；额定功率；评分；收视率；程度
words.example: The WWF's rating of this species shows how urgent protection is.

words.zh: adj. 灭绝的；破灭了的，消亡了的；熄灭了的；（火山）死的
words.example: The dodo bird became extinct hundreds of years ago.

words.zh: n. 灭绝；熄灭；消失；【生】灭绝
words.example: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.

words.zh: v. 聚集；  n. 大量，一堆；大多数；群众；[物]质量；团，块，堆；【化】质量；【物】质量；【数】质量；  adj. 大量的；广泛的
words.example: A mass of plastic waste threatens the lives of seabirds.

words.zh: n. 栖息地，生活环境；【生】栖息地
words.example: The natural habitat of giant pandas is the bamboo forest.

words.zh: adj. 意识到的；知道的；对……有意识的
words.example: Are you aware that many species are in danger?

words.zh: phr. 意识到，知道
words.example: They are aware of the importance of protecting endangered species.

words.zh: vt. 危及，危害
words.example: Pollution and hunting can seriously endanger many rare animals.

words.zh: v. 平均为；  n. 平均数；平均水平；  adj. 通常的；一般的；平均的；平庸的，普通的；【数】平均值，均值
words.example: The average lifespan of a wild elephant is about sixty years.

words.zh: phr. 平均，通常
words.example: One hundred elephants are killed every day on average.

words.zh: n. 王子；王孙；亲王
words.example: The prince opened the new wildlife protection center last week.

words.zh: phr. 取得进步
words.example: We have made great progress in protecting the Tibetan antelope.

words.zh: v. 感兴趣；涉及；担心；关于；  n. 关心，关切；担心；所关切的事；（利害）关系；关注；【化】关注点
words.example: The destruction of forests is a major concern for many nations.

words.zh: adj. 关心的，关切的；担心的
words.example: The concerned scientists quickly called for new protections for whales.

words.zh: adj. 关心的，关切的；担心的
words.example: Many people are concerned about the rising number of endangered species.

words.zh: adj. 活的；居住的；在用的；  n. 生活，生计
words.example: Protecting wildlife means improving the living conditions of local communities.

words.zh: v. 适应；使适应；改编；改装，改造；【航】调节，使适应
words.example: It is hard for some animals to adapt in time.

words.zh: phr. （使）适应
words.example: Animals must adapt to the changing climate or die out.

words.zh: v. 测量，度量；估量；【化】测量；【数】测量，度量；【航】测量；  n. 措施，方法；尺寸；计量标准；(估价、判断的)标准，尺度
words.example: The government must measure the effect of pollution on wildlife.

words.zh: n. 权威，威信；当局，官方；权力，职权；当权者；权威人士；【航】权威，当局
words.example: The local authority has created a new nature reserve for birds.

words.zh: vt. 对……施加压力；密封；  n. 压力；压迫，[物] 压强；迫使；要求；催促；【化】压强；【物】压强
words.example: Huge pressure from farming has reduced many natural habitats.

words.zh: phr. 面临压力；被催逼
words.example: The panda population is under pressure from habitat loss.

words.zh: n. 鲸；氪佬；  v. <美，非正式>殴打，猛击
words.example: The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth.

words.zh: n. 羚羊
words.example: A herd of antelope ran across the open grassland.

words.zh: v. 预订；保留；保存；储备；推迟决定；  n. 储备；储备金；保护区；保留意见；保留；禁猎区；预备队员；拘谨；【财】预定；留出；储备
words.example: We should reserve some land for wildlife to live safely.

words.zh: adj. 朴素的，不做修饰的；平凡的；简单明了的；坦率的；清楚的，显而易见的；单纯的；  n. 平原；  adv. (用以加强语气)显然，非常
words.example: The wide plain is home to many grazing animals.

words.zh: phr. 理解；看清，听清，分清
words.example: Through the fog, we could make out a herd of elephants.

words.zh: n. 兽群，牧群；  v. 放牧，群集
words.example: A herd of wild horses moved slowly across the plain.

words.zh: v. 观察；注视；注意；说，评论；庆祝，纪念；遵守；【法】遵守，遵照；【医】观察；【化】观察
words.example: Students observe the birds' behavior every morning in the field.

words.zh: n. 美（丽）；美人；美丽的东西；美容品，化妆品
words.example: The beauty of the natural world inspires us to protect it.

words.zh: v. 提醒；使想起
words.example: Please remind me to feed the cat tomorrow.

words.zh: v. 提醒；使想起
words.example: The old picture reminds me of my grandfather's farm.

words.zh: n. 毛皮；毛皮外套；人造毛；软毛；  vt. 用毛皮覆盖
words.example: Poachers kill tigers for their fur and other body parts.

words.zh: adj. 神圣不可侵犯的；神圣的；宗教（性）的；不容更改的
words.example: In some cultures, certain animals are considered sacred.

words.zh: v. 射击，射伤；拍照；射出（光、亮等），放射；发射；射门；狩猎；（使朝某方向）冲，奔，扑，射，飞驰；拍摄，摄影；射门（又作strike）；  n. 新芽；嫩枝
words.example: It is illegal to shoot wild animals in this reserve.

words.zh: v. 得益，有益于；  n. 利润，盈利；益处
words.example: The company earns a large profit from selling rare animal skins.

words.zh: phr. 照管；监督
words.example: The ranger watches over the baby elephants until they are strong enough.

words.zh: phr. 日夜不停地，不断地
words.example: The rescue team worked day and night to save the trapped dolphins.

words.zh: v. 攻击，袭击；侵袭，侵蚀；毁坏；抨击；疾病发作；发动攻击；全力应对，奋力处理；【化】（疾病、化学药品、昆虫等）攻击，侵蚀；  n. 疾病发作；攻击，袭击；抨击
words.example: The wolf may attack sheep if it is hungry and has no other food.

words.zh: adj. 有效的；实际的；生效的
words.example: This new law is effective in reducing the illegal trade of wildlife.

words.zh: v. 痊愈，恢复健康；恢复；收回；换回；重新找到；重新获得；复苏；弥补；找回；【化】回收
words.example: After the rescue, the injured elephant slowly began to recover in the shelter.

words.zh: v. 去除；免除；脱去，摘下；移开；【航】去除；  n. 间距
words.example: Please remove the plastic bag from the turtle's shell carefully.

words.zh: v. 打算；想要；计划
words.example: We intend to set up a camera to observe the rare birds.

words.zh: n. 威胁，恐吓；凶兆；威胁的言论；【财】威胁
words.example: Habitat loss is a serious threat to the survival of many wild animals.

words.zh: v. 恐吓；危及；预示……的恶兆；威胁
words.example: Pollution and overfishing continue to threaten the balance of ocean life.

words.zh: vi. 生存，生活；存在
words.example: Many rare species cannot exist without a clean and safe environment.

words.zh: n. 和谐；和声；和睦；协调
words.example: Farmers and wild elephants can live in harmony if we manage the land wisely.

words.zh: n. 货物，商品
words.example: The customs officers checked all the goods in the truck for illegal wildlife products.

words.zh: n. 生物；动物；人；创造物
words.example: The panda is a gentle creature that has become a symbol of wildlife protection.

words.zh: n. 鹿（单复数同形）
words.example: A deer stood quietly beside the river while we watched through binoculars.

words.zh: n. 袋鼠
words.example: A kangaroo can jump a long distance when it feels threatened.

words.zh: v. 减少，减小，降低；精简；缩小；【化】还原；【数】简化，约分
words.example: We should reduce the use of plastic bags to protect marine animals.

words.zh: adv. 直接地，确切地；正对着；  adj. 拖欠的；到期的；欠债的，应给的；由于，因为；适当的；预期的；应有的；  n. 会费；应有的权利；应得到的东西
words.example: The report on wildlife protection is due next Friday.

words.zh: phr. 由于；因为
words.example: Many migratory birds changed their route due to the new construction.

words.zh: n. 昆虫
words.example: This insect helps pollinate flowers and is very important to the ecosystem.

words.zh: n. 网，网状物；通信网；球网；篮网；  adj. 纯利的，净值的，净的；  v. 用网捕；捕获；净赚；踢入球门
words.example: The rescue team used a net to catch the injured bird safely.

words.zh: n. 邻近地区；街区，居民区；城区；社区；邻里情谊，邻居间的友善关系
words.example: People in our neighbourhood have started a project to feed homeless cats.

words.zh: n. 双筒望远镜
words.example: We borrowed a pair of binoculars to watch the eagles from a distance.

words.zh: phr. 搜寻，寻找
words.example: The team searched for the lost wolf cub for hours.

words.zh: n. 海豚
words.example: We saw a dolphin jump out of the water near the boat.

words.zh: n. 树袋熊，考拉
words.example: The koala in the tree was sleeping peacefully during the day.

words.zh: v. 搅拌，搅动；搅和；激发（兴趣）；轰动；动，移动；挪动，活动，离开 ；激动；【化】搅拌；  n. 感动，激动，愤怒，震动；搅拌；骚乱
words.example: Please stir the mixture slowly until the sugar is completely dissolved.

words.zh: phr. 激起；唤起；搅拌；煽动
words.example: The documentary was made to stir up public interest in saving the tigers.

words.zh: n. 情绪，情感；强烈的感情；感性
words.example: The rescue of the baby whale stirred a deep emotion in all the volunteers.

words.zh: v. 剥皮；去皮；  n. 皮肤；皮，外皮；兽皮，毛皮；果皮；【医】皮肤；【生】皮肤；  adj. <俚>色情的
words.example: The polar bear's thick skin protects it from the cold.

words.zh: adj. 不寻常的，不常见的；与众不同的
words.example: It is unusual to see so many butterflies in this area in winter.
